Cabin Safety

ควบคุมฝูงชน

The actions taken by crew to maintain order, direct movement, and prevent bottlenecks during emergency evacuations or abnormal situations.

Definition

The actions taken by crew to maintain order, direct movement, and prevent bottlenecks during emergency evacuations or abnormal situations.

Operational example

During evacuation, crew must practice effective crowd control to keep aisles clear and prevent passenger congestion.
